lead: Tesoro Gold's maiden Ore Reserve at Ternera dominated the window: 42.8Mt at 0.93g/t Au for 1.28Moz, converting roughly 87% of the Measured and Indicated Resource and underpinning a mine life of more than 13 years at a planned 3.0Mtpa processing rate, with the Definitive Feasibility Study still targeted for completion during CY2026.
subtitle: Ternera's maiden reserve headlines a session otherwise dominated by resource growth and study timing slippage.
subject: TSO books maiden 1.28Moz Ore Reserve at Ternera
watch_items: Aurum's next Boundiali Mineral Resource update, targeted for early in the December 2026 quarter, ahead of a DFS due late CY2026.
Caravel Copper DFS, now pushed to the fourth quarter of calendar 2026 pending metallurgical, groundwater, environmental and capex workstreams.
Lefroy's combined Mt Martin Scoping Study incorporating Burns, due early in the December 2026 quarter.
QMines' nine-hole, 1,500m drilling program at Botos targeting a maiden resource, following the Mt Chalmers land settlement on 30 October 2026.
Anson's Notice of Intent to Drill submission at Yellow Cat, with Phase 2 assay results expected early next year.
Barys rights trading under code BRYR closes 30 September 2026.
day_in_brief:
Reserves and resources: Tesoro Gold delivered a maiden Ore Reserve of 42.8Mt at 0.93g/t Au for 1.28Moz at Ternera, converting about 87% of the Measured and Indicated Resource and supporting a 13+ year mine life at 3.0Mtpa, with first-decade grade of 1.16g/t Au. Nexus Minerals lifted its combined group Mineral Resource to 14Mt at 1.6g/t Au for 709,000oz, with Wallbrook alone growing 108% to 13.3Mt at 1.5g/t Au for 631,000oz and Crusader-Templar now past half a million ounces.

Drilling and exploration: Aurum Resources reported high-grade gold beyond the current resource at Boundiali, with best results of 1.35m @ 43.32g/t Au from 17m at BMT1 and 2.38m @ 22.01g/t Au from 277m at BMT2, feeding a Mineral Resource update targeted for early in the December quarter. QMines will settle a A$2.388 million land acquisition at Mt Chalmers on 30 October 2026, unlocking drilling at the Botos deposit under an Exploration Target of 1.5 to 2.5Mt @ 0.5 to 0.8g/t Au, with a nine-hole, 1,500m program now underway. Anson Resources cleared an environmental baseline survey at Yellow Cat with no roadblocks identified, paving the way for a Notice of Intent to Drill and Phase 2 twin-hole drilling ahead of a maiden resource.

Studies and timing: Caravel Minerals pushed its Caravel Copper DFS back to the fourth quarter of calendar 2026, citing metallurgical testwork, groundwater modelling, an updated Environmental Review Document and a process plant capex review, with Final Investment Decision still targeted for the end of 2027. Lefroy Exploration is weighing folding the high-grade Burns deposit (4.22Mt @ 1.18g/t Au for 159,285oz) into the Mt Martin Scoping Study, now slipping to early in the December 2026 quarter, while its Lucky Strike Miscellaneous Licence has been fully granted with dewatering targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

Corporate: Barys Resources' renounceable entitlement offer began rights trading under code BRYR, targeting up to A$2.6 million, with trading closing 30 September 2026. Twelve quarterly and annual filings were lodged across the watchlist, none carrying guidance changes.

summaries.heading: Boundiali drilling extends high-grade gold beyond resource
summaries.body: Aurum Resources has assayed 60 diamond holes for 12,251.55m at the BMT1 deposit and BMT2 prospect within its 3.22Moz Boundiali Gold Project in Côte d'Ivoire. Best results include 1.35m @ 43.32g/t Au from 17m at BMT1 and 2.38m @ 22.01g/t Au from 277m at BMT2, which sits outside the current Mineral Resource. Results will feed into the next Boundiali Mineral Resource update targeted for early in the December quarter, ahead of a DFS due late CY2026. Aurum held A$54.6 million cash at 30 June 2026.

summaries.heading: Land deal unlocks Botos deposit for drilling
summaries.body: QMines will acquire two freehold properties totalling 25.52ha over the Botos deposit at Mt Chalmers for $2.388 million, settling 30 October 2026, removing the land access constraint that had blocked drilling. Botos carries an Exploration Target of 1.5 to 2.5Mt @ 0.5 to 0.8g/t Au, 0.1 to 0.2% Cu and 1.1 to 1.4% Zn, with historical drilling including 33m @ 0.80g/t Au, 0.16% Cu, 1.82% Zn, 0.93% Pb and 47g/t Ag from 75m (BTDDH01). A nine-hole, 1,500m program is underway targeting a maiden resource.

summaries.heading: Lefroy to weigh Burns inclusion in Mt Martin Scoping Study
summaries.body: Lefroy Exploration is assessing whether to fold the high-grade portion of its Burns gold deposit into the Mt Martin Scoping Study to capture regional processing synergies. The combined study, along with a review of Burns' existing 4.22Mt @ 1.18g/t Au (159,285oz) resource, is now due early in the December 2026 quarter, slipping from the prior timeline. Separately, Miscellaneous Licence L25/71 at Lucky Strike is now fully granted after a Heritage Agreement, with dewatering and mining targeted to resume in the first quarter of 2027.

summaries.heading: Tesoro delivers maiden 1.28Moz Ore Reserve at Ternera
summaries.body: Tesoro Gold has reported a maiden Ore Reserve of 42.8Mt at 0.93g/t Au for 1.28Moz of contained gold at the Ternera deposit, El Zorro Gold Project in Chile, entirely within a single open pit. The Reserve converts approximately 87% of the 1.47Moz Measured and Indicated Resource and supports more than 13 years of production at a planned 3.0Mtpa processing rate, at 1.16g/t Au for the first 10 years. The result underpins the Definitive Feasibility Study targeted for completion during CY2026.

summaries.heading: Tesoro books maiden 1.28Moz Ore Reserve at Ternera
summaries.body: Tesoro Gold has declared a maiden Ore Reserve of 42.8Mt at 0.93g/t Au for 1.28Moz of contained gold at the Ternera deposit, El Zorro Gold Project in Chile, entirely within a single open pit. The Reserve converts approximately 87% of the 1.47Moz Measured and Indicated Resource and underpins a 13+ year mine life at a 3.0Mtpa processing rate, with average grade of 1.16g/t Au over the first 10 years. The pit shell was optimised at a US$3,000/oz gold price. A Definitive Feasibility Study is targeted for completion during CY2026.

summaries.heading: Caravel pushes Caravel Copper DFS back to fourth quarter
summaries.body: Caravel Minerals has rescheduled release of the Definitive Feasibility Study for its 100%-owned Caravel Copper Project to the fourth quarter of calendar 2026, from the September 2026 timing previously guided. The delay covers four workstreams: an eight-week metallurgical programme to lift concentrate grade and recovery and confirm gold and silver recoveries, numerical groundwater modelling of the Yarragadee and Leederville aquifers, an updated Environmental Review Document ahead of EPA assessment, and full review of the process plant capital cost estimate. On release, the company moves into funding and joint venture partnering ahead of a Final Investment Decision targeted for the end of 2027.

summaries.heading: Anson clears environmental survey hurdle at Yellow Cat U-V project
summaries.body: Anson Resources has completed the environmental baseline field survey across the western and central blocks at its Yellow Cat Uranium Vanadium Project in Utah, identifying no environmental roadblocks. The survey covered all proposed drill pads, access tracks and buffer zones, and will support a Notice of Intent to Drill submission to the BLM and UDOGM. Phase 2 drilling to twin 3 to 5 historic holes is planned next, targeting a maiden JORC 2012 compliant resource, with assay results expected early next year.

summaries.heading: Nexus group resources climb to 709,000oz gold
summaries.body: Nexus Minerals has lifted its combined group Mineral Resource to 14Mt at 1.6g/t Au for 709,000oz, including Wallbrook and Pinnacles. The Wallbrook estimate alone grew 108% to 13.3Mt at 1.5g/t Au for 631,000oz, with Crusader-Templar now past half a million ounces and maiden resources added at Payns and Branches. Diamond drilling to support resource conversion and new prospect definition is planned to start in October.

summaries.heading: Barys rights trading opens for renounceable entitlement offer
summaries.body: Rights to Barys Resources' renounceable entitlement offer, announced 14 September 2026 to raise up to A$2.6 million, began trading today under code BRYR. Rights trading closes on 30 September 2026, giving shareholders the option to take up entitlements in full, partially participate, or sell rights on market.
